views.purpose: The cnc-runtime viewpoint is chosen because its runtime components and connectors directly answer the connectivity and control-flow questions regarding the seat booking process, unlike static structure or code mapping views.
required_evidence: runtime components involved in the seat booking process
connectors and communication channels linking the components
sequence of calls between components during a booking request
views.diagram_language_rule: viewpoint agent chose plantuml: PlantUML can accurately represent runtime components, connectors, and communication channels necessary for illustrating runtime connectivity and interaction sequences.

notes: Eligible because they frame the chosen concerns: module-decomposition, context, cnc-runtime, code-mapping

module-decomposition was rejected because it focuses on static modules and maintainability rather than runtime interactions and connectors; context was rejected because it operates at too high a system boundary level and misses internal component interactions; code-mapping was rejected because it provides implementation-level types rather than the high-level runtime components and connectors needed to answer connectivity and control-flow questions.

diagram language plantuml: viewpoint agent chose plantuml: PlantUML can accurately represent runtime components, connectors, and communication channels necessary for illustrating runtime connectivity and interaction sequences.
